proof_tree.goal: In Hardy & Wright's Bernoulli indexing (B_1 = 1/6, B_2 = 1/30, ..., so B_k = |B_{2k}| in modern even-index notation), prove that for every prime k of the form 3n + 1 the rational B_k - 1/6 is an integer, i.e. B_k = 1/6 (mod 1).
